title: Start from an image
description: Use a photo or drawing as the starting point for a new still image.

sections.title: Choose the right workflow
paragraphs: Use Z-Image Turbo or Qwen-Image 2512 when you want to reinterpret a picture: explore a different style, mood, or version of a scene. For a targeted instruction such as changing one object’s color, try FLUX.2 klein and the photo-editing guide.

sections.title: Add your starting picture
steps: Select Z-Image Turbo or Qwen-Image 2512 in the model menu.
Click Start from beside the prompt. Choose a picture from the library or use Choose File… for a local photo. You can also drop a picture into that box.
Check the thumbnail so you know which picture will be used. Zephra accepts one reference picture at a time.
Choose an output Size with the shape you want. The size menu offers choices based on the reference’s proportions; custom dimensions may be adjusted to the model’s supported sizes.

sections.title: Describe the new version
steps: Describe the finished image you want rather than giving only an editing command.
Begin with the default Strength of 0.60 and the model’s default Steps. Click Generate.
Compare the completed result to the starting picture. Lower Strength to preserve more of its structure; raise it to allow a larger change. Keep the prompt and seed steady while comparing.
sections.prompt: A watercolor illustration of the garden path in the starting picture, with soft green foliage, delicate washes of color, and warm afternoon light. The path remains the main focus.

sections.title: Understand Strength
paragraphs: For these two models, Strength ranges from 0.10 to 0.90. It controls how much the starting picture is reworked. Low values may make very little change, especially with a small step count. High values may change the subject or composition substantially.
This is a whole-image transformation. It does not protect faces, text, or selected areas. Zephra does not offer a masking brush for editing only one region.

sections.title: Start another experiment
paragraphs: Use the × on the reference thumbnail to return to generation from text alone. Right-click the thumbnail for From Library…, Choose File…, or Clear.

If you want to use an edited result itself as the next starting picture, export it and choose that file. Reusing a saved edit through Use as Reference can restore its original source, which is useful for trying a different edit of the same original.
